summary: Wife of James Smith and a granddaughter of Capt. Elnathan Topping of Sagg, Southampton; John's 8th-great-grandmother.
bio:
Jerusha Topping was born at Southampton, Suffolk County, New York, about 1698, though the accounts place her birth anywhere between 1695 and 1705. The best evidence makes her a daughter of Elnathan Topping Jr. (1664–1751) and his wife Mary, and so a granddaughter of Captain Elnathan and Mary (Cooper) Topping and a great-granddaughter of Thomas Topping. Her father's will of September 1751 left five shillings each to his daughters Phebe, Mary and Jerusha, a token sum consistent with a daughter already married; her brothers and sisters were Elnathan, Job, Silas, Luther, Zephaniah, Mary and Phebe. Some published genealogies instead give her parents as Josiah Topping and Hannah Sayre, or as Jonathan and Mary Topping, but neither version fits the 1751 will.

About 1720 she married James Smith; their eldest son Matthew was born on 3 September 1721, and a daughter Temperance in the early 1730s. Jerusha died in 1760 at Long Island City, Queens. She was John's 8th-great-grandmother.

researchNotes:
Born about 1695–1705 (reports suggest this range; tree gives 1698–1760). Howell (1887, pp. 395–396) lists the younger Elnathan Topping (b. 20 Aug 1664, d. Sept 1751), who 'had w. Mary and ch. as by will … Elnathan, Job, Silas, Luther, Zephaniah, Mary, Phebe and Jerusha'. The will of Elnathan Topping of Southampton, 15 Sep 1751, proved 30 Sep 1751 (NY Wills IV, Liber 18 pp. 391–2) gives 5s each to 'my daughters, Phebe, Mary, and Jerusha' — it does not call her Smith, but a token 5s fits a married daughter. The jrm Needham site attached the F. K. Smith quote to the elder Capt. Elnathan; F. K. Smith itself says Elnathan (d. Sep 1751) was 'a son of Captain Elnathan and Mary (Cooper) Topping and a grandson of Thomas Topping', making Jerusha a granddaughter of Capt. Elnathan. TREE: shows her parents as Josiah Topping (1663–1726) + Hannah Sayre (1668–1741), with Topping arms image; Round 1 removed these (Daniel Sayre's 1707 will names 'Hannah Topping the wife of Mr Josiah Topping'; Banks Sayre Family p. 30 lists only Josiah and John b. 1706). Charles E. Topping's 1980 Topping Genealogy p. 392 (repeated on WikiTree Smith-141655) still gives the Josiah line, which does not fit Banks's evidence.

Weygant's Family Record (1897) names Jerusha as 'daughter of Elnathan Topping, Jr., son of Capt. Elnathan Topping, who was born Aug. 6, 1640'. It dates her marriage to James Smith 'about the year 1720' ([R4-S1]). Weygant is independent of, and earlier than, F. K. Smith (1967), who gives the same parentage. Pelletreau's date for the eldest son Matthew, 3 Sept 1721, fixes the marriage by 1720 ([R4-S2]). That puts Jerusha's birth no later than c.1700, which fits a daughter of Elnathan Jr. (b. 1664) and suits a daughter Temperance born in the early 1730s. The tree's Josiah Topping & Hannah Sayre parentage comes from C. E. Topping (1980), and a third version ('Jonathan (2) and Mary Topping', Genealogies of the State of New York vol. 2) appears on WikiTree ([R4-S3]). Both conflict with the 1751 will of Elnathan Topping, which names a daughter Jerusha (round 3).
